description: This PHP class 'PublisherUtilities' provides utility functions for processing and comparing titles and content, likely used within a Confluence publishing context. It includes methods for generating nice titles and determining whether content should be updated based on similarity thresholds.

classes.name: PublisherUtilities
classes.description: A utility class for handling title normalization and content update decision logic in a Confluence publishing workflow.

methods.name: niceTitle
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly title from a filename, replacing 'index.html' with 'Homepage' and cleaning up other HTML filenames.

methods.name: shouldUpdate
methods.description: Determines if local content should replace published content based on content similarity and a configurable threshold, with optional debug output.
